newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM drops cargo fuel surcharge from April.
newsitem.headline: KLM drops cargo fuel surcharge from April.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Friday it was dropping its worldwide cargo fuel surcharge with effect from April 15.
The carrier introduced the surcharge of 0.20 guilders per kilogram last November, following a sharp rise in fuel prices.
"On the basis of the price of aviation fuel, which has been getting cheaper for some time, KLM Cargo has decided to scrap the current worldwide surcharge...from April 15," KLM said in a statement.
"KLM Cargo has taken this decision in the expectation that the fuel price will not rise substantially in the near future," it added.

KLM said it had agreed with Dutch shippers that, if a surcharge had to be reimposed in future, a period of 30 days would be observed between the announcement of the charge and the date of introduction. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
